title: StructuralPro Product Architecture
sync_rules: Every website product id must be unique.
Website capability_ids must exist in core/platform/parity.py.
Product status must be Available, Integration, or Planned.
The catalog must contain exactly 29 specialized products plus 1 Enterprise platform.
Planned specialist products must not be presented as released software.
Do not duplicate the product catalog inside HTML; website pages consume website/data/products.json.
